info.title: RAILSHOT shared workspace product API
info.description: Implemented local contract. Public demo requires exact configured Host/Origin and no login or browser bearer. Server-only provider/GitHub/Ansible credentials are never request fields. Private operator mode may require its existing internal bearer. One API process on one host, durable private state, one unfinished operation; no multi-replica scheduler. Legacy POST /api/deploy and GET /api/runs/{run_id} preserve response shape and use the same durable run binding. Local contract tests are not cloud deployment evidence.

post.description: Persist a normalized private source snapshot and execution intent before any external mutation. Without plan_id, require the registered target and application in the CD configuration. Optional plan_id consumes an executable, unexpired, unchanged plan for the same app and target; its profile must include deployment registration. Complete environment execution and registration before CI, verified publication and CD. Environment or database success alone does not mean application deployment succeeded. One unfinished operation including unknown occupies the single worker. Same GitHub URL/key reuses the first SHA without refetching HEAD; plan_id is part of idempotent input.

post.description: Strict JSON. name is an application name of 3 through 30 characters. Operator profiles expose no credentials or local paths. Execution supports one registered AWS/GCP amd64 runtime node with database.mode=none or configured Patroni placements. Each placement must exactly match its registered database, DCS voter and proxy role counts; the combined topology needs at least two database nodes, at least three odd-numbered DCS voters and at least one proxy. standalone and unsupported runtime counts/providers/topologies produce a saved non-executable plan with blockers. Plans expire after 15 minutes, bind policy and target snapshots plus every provider plan digest, and admit only new resources without changes to existing resources. Plan creation uses the same execution admission lock. A saved or executable plan is not deployment evidence. For profiles with deployment configuration, the target database binding requirement must equal whether the request uses patroni; mismatches produce DATABASE_BINDING_PROFILE_MISMATCH before Terraform planning. Profiles without deployment configuration can independently select database preparation.

post.description: Execute a saved, unexpired, unchanged, operator-enabled plan once. The same plan cannot also be consumed by a deployment or another idempotency key. Record resource, guest, runtime, optional Patroni database and optional deployment registration results separately. deployment_supported becomes true only after registration succeeds; successful runtime preparation alone does not register the target. This endpoint does not build or deploy application source and does not verify public application HTTP.

supported.description: Whether provider, runtime purpose and operator execution policy permit this profile. Not a live readiness result.

target_id.description: Fixed runtime target authorized by this profile.

application_name.description: Application from the optional deployment configuration; null when no application is configured.

deployment_supported.description: Whether the profile contains deployment configuration. This is configuration capability, not completed target registration.

required.description: Whether this profile's registered application target requires a database binding. When deployment configuration exists, its binding requirement must match database.mode=patroni before Terraform planning.

database.description: Configured Patroni role counts, or null. One VM may have both database and DCS roles, so the counts are not necessarily distinct VM counts. Plan validation checks the requested topology.

publication.description: CI artifact receipt validated by the registered GitHub workflow; publication is not application deployment.

migration.description: Optional observed migration Job result. Its success alone does not establish application deployment or public HTTP success.

plan_id.description: Optional saved plan consumed before CI for this deployment.

environment_id.description: Present with plan_id; the deployment UUID followed by .environment identifies its private execution state. This is not a separately registered /environments/{id} resource.

node_count.description: Accepted range is 1 through 64; current execution supports exactly one runtime node. Other values produce SINGLE_NODE_ONLY.

mode.description: none skips database preparation and requires absent or empty placements. patroni uses registered placements. standalone is accepted as input but produces STANDALONE_DATABASE_UNSUPPORTED.

placements.description: Requested role counts must exactly match each referenced profile. Duplicate profiles and unsupported or insufficient combined topologies block execution.

node_count.description: Accepted range is 1 through 64; current execution supports exactly one runtime node. Other values produce SINGLE_NODE_ONLY.

mode.description: none skips database preparation and requires absent or empty placements. patroni uses registered placements. standalone is accepted as input but produces STANDALONE_DATABASE_UNSUPPORTED.

placements.description: Requested role counts must exactly match each referenced profile. Duplicate profiles and unsupported or insufficient combined topologies block execution.

steps.description: Planned work: resources, guest, runtime; database and binding when a database is requested; registration when deployment configuration exists. These labels do not prove execution or map one-to-one to progress.stage.

stage.description: Current or last environment step, such as provision, resources, guest, runtime, database or binding. A succeeded environment may retain its last step name.

nodes.description: Applied runtime and database VM descriptors. Present after all resource applications succeed; not guest, runtime or database readiness.

deployment_supported.description: True only after deployment target registration succeeds. Runtime or database success alone is insufficient.

binding.description: Deployment target registration, including the private database binding when one was produced.

repository_url.description: Public HTTPS GitHub owner/repository URL. Default branch SHA is pinned once.

plan_id.description: Optional only for POST /api/v1/deployments. The plan name and fixed runtime target must match app and target_id, and its profile must support deployment registration.

archive.description: ZIP; at most 100 MiB expanded and 2,000 files.

plan_id.description: Optional only for POST /api/v1/deployments. The plan name and fixed runtime target must match app and target_id, and its profile must support deployment registration.

paths.description: JSON string array, one safe relative path per files entry.

Source.description: Exactly one source. source_type is optional and must match if supplied. Reject unknown fields and duplicate singleton fields; only files may repeat. Credentials, provider URLs and SSH paths are not accepted. Optional plan_id is accepted only by deployments, not builds or legacy deploy.

nodes.description: Applied runtime and database VM descriptors. Present after all resource applications succeed; not guest, runtime or database readiness.

deployment_supported.description: True only after deployment target registration succeeds. Runtime or database success alone is insufficient.

binding.description: Deployment target registration, including the private database binding when one was produced.

EnvironmentProgress.description: Embedded environment execution progress. Initially only status=queued is present. Environment completion is separate from CI, application CD and public HTTP verification.
